Kristina Novak (born 3 August 2000) is a Slovenian tennis player. Novak has a career-high singles ranking by the WTA of 790, reached on 9 June 2025. She also has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 283, achieved on 9 June 2025. At the end of 2018, she played in the doubles finals of the ITF tournaments held in Italy. [ 1 ] In July 2024, She became champion in doubles with Swedish Lisa Zaar in the tournament held in Brežice , Slovenia. [ 2 ] In 2022, she played her first career singles final in Krško , Slovenia where she was defeated by Czech Aneta Kučmová . [ 3 ] In April 2025, she won her first major tournament at the ITF W75 Koper Open in Koper, Slovenia with her partner Czech Ivana Šebestová .
